topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I heard someone had tattooed my work on their skin, a warmth spread through me, unexpected and deep. I never imagined my creation would become a part of someone in such a permanent way. It's an honor, really, to think that my art has moved someone so profoundly that they wanted to carry it with them always. The ink on their skin is a living testament to the connection we form through our creations. It’s a braid of personal narrative and shared vision, a bond formed without words, sealed in time and flesh. I’m deeply moved.
